caption:
You tug one corner and the opposite corner pops loose.

Deep mattresses taller than a standard mattress stretch a regular fitted sheet past its limit. The elastic can't reach all the way around, so pulling one corner tight lifts the opposite one right off. It usually happens in the middle of the night, not when you're making the bed.

This one is cut specifically for deep mattresses, sized to fit eighteen to twenty four inches, in a soft, wrinkle-resistant steel blue that reaches every corner without fighting the fabric.

That means no more remaking the bed at midnight, just a sheet that actually stays put, for about $25.
